children: VANCOUVER, British Columbia, Oct. 20, 2026

-- Monument Mining Limited (“Monument” or the “Company”) provides an update regarding the Tuckanarra Gold Project joint venture in Western Australia between Monument’s wholly owned subsidiary, Monument Murchison Pty Ltd (“Monument Murchison”), holding a 20% participating interest, and Tuckanarra Resources Pty Ltd (“Tuckanarra”), a subsidiary of Odyssey Gold Ltd (“Odyssey”), holding an 80% participating interest.
Court Proceedings

Tuckanarra Resources Pty Ltd (“Tuckanarra”) has commenced proceedings in the Supreme Court of Western Australia and applied for an interlocutory injunction to prevent Monument Murchison Pty Ltd (“Monument Murchison”) from holding the Management Committee meeting scheduled for October 21, 2026. Monument Murchison called that meeting for the purpose of appointing a Replacement Manager following its position that Tuckanarra ceased to be Manager under the Exploration Joint Venture Agreement (“EJVA”). The application also seeks to restrain certain related steps in reliance on Monument Murchison’s August 25, 2026 notice of breach.
The parties have agreed interim arrangements and an expedited timetable for resolution of the dispute. The outcome and terms of any court orders remain subject to determination.

Monument Murchison maintains that Tuckanarra ceased to be Manager under clause 5.1(b)(ii) of the EJVA. Any interim arrangements in place are without any admission concerning the validity of Tuckanarra’s removal as Manager. Monument Murchison reserves its rights under the EJVA.
Joint Venture Dispute

As previously disclosed, Monument Murchison issued a notice of breach to Tuckanarra on August 25, 2026 under the EJVA dated October 13, 2020, concerning Tuckanarra’s entry into a toll milling agreement with a third party.

Monument Murchison maintains that the material breach was not remedied within the contractual period and that Tuckanarra ceased to be Manager of the joint venture effective September 25, 2026 pursuant to clause 5.1(b)(ii) of the EJVA.
Tuckanarra disputes Monument Murchison’s position regarding the breach and removal.
Monument’s Position
Monument remains committed to the orderly advancement of the Tuckanarra Gold Project in accordance with the EJVA and the respective rights and obligations of the joint venture participants.

Monument supports the evaluation of commercially viable development and processing arrangements, including third-party toll milling, provided that such arrangements are appropriately authorised and protect the rights of both joint venture participants.
Monument intends to continue engaging constructively in the dispute resolution process while preserving its rights under the EJVA.
The Company will provide further updates as material developments occur.
Cathy Zhai, President and CEO

About
Monument

Monument Mining Limited (TSX-V: MMY, FSE: D7Q1) is an established Canadian gold producer that 100% owns and operates the Selinsing Gold Mine in Malaysia and the Murchison Gold Project in the Murchison area of Western Australia. It has 20% interest in Tuckanarra Gold Project, jointly owned by Odyssey Gold Ltd in the same region. The Company employs approximately 297 people in both regions and is committed to the highest standards of environmental management, social responsibility, including health and safety for its employees and neighboring communities and good corporate governance.
